title: Cayley Tournaments Simultaneously Critical for the Clique and Dichromatic Numbers
summary: For a tournament $T$, let $ω(T)$ be the minimum clique number among the backedge graphs of $T$, and let $χ(T)$ be its dichromatic number. We give a template-lifting construction. It turns a $k$-template into a regular, vertex-transitive Cayley tournament that is simultaneously $(k+1)$-$ω$-critical and $(k+1)$-$χ$-critical. The output is also a $(k+1)$-template. Iterating the construction, we prove that for every $k\geq3$, there is a positive even integer $m_k$ with the following property.
